blocks.text: **Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware (CVE-2025-34035); (2) isolate or patch exposed Mitel MiCollab (CVE-2026-133323); (3) isolate or patch exposed Vates Xen Orchestra (CVE-2026-133469); (4) close previously reported Project MONAI MONAI Label, N-able MailAssure, Idunno AntiCsrf and Drupal Core KEV exposure; (5) examine Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware hosts for unexpected child processes and outbound connections.

**CVE-2025-34035 - Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware OS command injection (CVSS 10).** An OS command injection vulnerability exists in EnGenius EnShare Cloud Service version 1.4.11 and earlier. The usbinteract.cgi script fails to properly sanitize user input passed to the path parameter, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary shell commands. The injected commands are executed with root privileges, leading to full system compromise. Affected releases (NVD): esr300 firmware = 1.1.0.28; esr300 firmware = 1.3.1.42; esr300 firmware = 1.4.0; +22 more. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-133323 - Mitel MiCollab OS command injection (CVSS 10).** A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1864. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-133469 - Vates Xen Orchestra authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8).** XO (Xen Orchestra) is a solution to visualize, manage, backup and delegate your XCP-ng (or XenServer) infrastructure. Prior to 6.9.2 and 6.10.1, REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token;. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-103406 - Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS command injection (CVSS 9.8).** An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command vulnerability in the AutomatedProvisioner in Juniper Networks Session Smart Conductor allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID. Affected releases (NVD): session smart conductor < 7.0.5-14-lts; session smart conductor >= 7.1.0-50r1, < 7.1.7-15-sts; session smart conductor >= 7.2.0-29r1, < 7.2.3-8r2. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): session smart conductor 7.0.5-14-lts, session smart conductor 7.1.7-15-sts, session smart conductor 7.2.3-8r2. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**Defensive hunting:** for Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware (CVE-2025-34035), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for Mitel MiCollab (CVE-2026-133323), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for Vates Xen Orchestra (CVE-2026-133469), review administrative logins, newly created accounts or API tokens, and configuration changes made without a matching change record; for Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router (CVE-2026-103406), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host.
